BiblicalUsage: Gabbai is named once, in Nehemiah 11:8, among the men who came to live in Jerusalem after the wall was rebuilt. After him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight. He is one of the residents who filled the holy city again.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rebuilding of Jerusalem needed residents as much as it needed a wall. Gabbai came and lived there, and I hold that the quiet choice to dwell in the city of God is itself an act of faith.
